entities.name: Query glycine cleavage P subunit 1
observations: 446 aa sequence; exact sequence hash match to UniProt B6YT11 from Thermococcus onnurineus.
Contains Pfam GDC-P domain PF02347.23 spanning residues 4–442.
Annotated as glycine dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) subunit 1 of the glycine cleavage system.
The P-protein binds glycine through pyridoxal phosphate and releases CO2; the aminomethyl group is transferred to the H-protein lipoamide.

entities.name: B6YT11
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Thermococcus onnurineus; exact sequence hash match to the query.
Function: glycine dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) subunit 1 in the glycine cleavage system.
The P-protein binds the alpha-amino group of glycine via pyridoxal phosphate, releases CO2, and transfers the remaining methylamine moiety to the H-protein lipoamide.

entities.name: Glycine cleavage decarboxylation
observations: Rhea representation: N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[glycine-cleavage complex H protein] + glycine + H+ = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-aminomethyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[glycine-cleavage complex H protein] + CO2.
The reaction is catalyzed by the PLP-dependent P component of the glycine cleavage system; EC 1.4.4.2.
